why: an unconditional wait is time the cook has to set aside
every row written before migration 050 carries no when_kind, and all of them are unconditional
an explicit null when_kind reads as always, the same as the key being absent
coconut-curried-golden-lentils soaks the lentils if there is time, so the hours are not blocked out
no-knead-bread rests the dough 45 to 60 minutes only when it went to the refrigerator
two overnights on the same night are one night of waiting, so the second is not added
an alongside wait is decided by its when_kind, so a null pointer does not put it back in the figure (the next save normalizes the row to always)
a wait whose step became a heading KEEPS counting: the step's kind says nothing about how long the cook waits
and the same wait after the step is deleted outright, pointer nulled by ON DELETE SET NULL
an alongside wait whose overlapped step became a heading: alongside_no is null so the page prints no qualifier, and it is still out of the figure
an optional wait whose step became a heading is still optional
a when_kind no picker can produce is not 'always', so it is left out rather than guessed in
an extension never enters the figure, and it does not change whether the wait itself does
a wait with no readable minutes still counts as a wait; planahead.total is what skips a null
